svg.title: How the Agent Factory Stack scores
svg.desc: Scorecard for the Agent Factory Stack, an architectural judgment and not a measured benchmark. Overall 9.4 out of 10. MCP readiness 10 (stateless SDK v2 handler, OAuth for MCP and MCP Apps built in); AI-assisted development 10 (one typed language, strict schemas, docs Claude knows well); Developer productivity 9.5 (no servers, one-command deploys, a Neon branch per step); Scalability 9.5 (Workers scale per request; Postgres is the limit to plan for); Cost efficiency potential 9.5 (every step fits free plans; the client pays for the model); Learning curve 9 (four foundations, but many Cloudflare services by step 13); Vendor independence 8.5 (Postgres, MCP and TypeScript move; DO, Queues, Workflows don’t). The weakest score is vendor independence, because Durable Objects, Queues and Workflows run only on Cloudflare.
